title: The interaction between dynamic ligand signaling and epigenetics in Notch-induced cancer metastasis.
authors: Chen, Tianchi; Al-Radhawi, M Ali; Levine, Herbert; Sontag, Eduardo D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Notch信号与表观遗传调控在黑色素瘤转移中的动态模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Metastatic melanoma presents a formidable challenge in oncology due to its high invasiveness and resistance to current treatments. Central to its ability to metastasize is the Notch signaling pathway, which, when activated through direct cell-cell interactions, propels cells into a metastatic state through mechanisms akin to the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). While the upregulation of miR-222 has been identified as a critical step in this metastatic progression, the mechanism through which this upregulation persists in the absence of active Notch signaling remains unclear. Here we introduce a dynamical system model that integrates miR-222 gene regulation with histone feedback mechanisms. Through computational analysis spanning both sustained and pulsatile ligand inputs, we delineate the non-linear decision boundaries that govern melanoma cell fate transitions, taking into account the dynamics of Notch signaling and the role of epigenetic modifications. Dimensional analysis reduces the 11-parameter system to three critical control groups governing chromatin modification rates and feedback strengths, providing a theoretical framework for parameter selection in the absence of complete kinetic measurements. Global sensitivity analysis identifies PRC2-mediated methylation and KDM5A-mediated demethylation as the dominant control parameters, while stochastic simulations show population heterogeneity consistent with the variable EMT responses observed in cancer cell populations. Our analysis examines the interplay between Notch signaling pathways and epigenetic regulation in dictating melanoma cell fate.
abstract_zh: 转移性黑色素瘤因其高侵袭性和对现有疗法的抵抗性，在肿瘤学中构成严峻挑战。其转移能力的核心在于Notch信号通路，该通路通过直接细胞间相互作用被激活时，以类似于上皮-间质转化（EMT）的机制推动细胞进入转移状态。尽管miR-222的上调已被确定为这一转移进程中的关键步骤，但在缺乏活跃Notch信号的情况下，这种上调如何持续存在的机制仍不清楚。在此，我们引入一个整合miR-222基因调控与组蛋白反馈机制的动力学系统模型。通过涵盖持续性和脉冲性配体输入的计算分析，我们描绘了调控黑色素瘤细胞命运转变的非线性决策边界，同时考虑了Notch信号动力学和表观遗传修饰的作用。量纲分析将11参数系统简化为三个关键控制组，分别控制染色质修饰速率和反馈强度，为在缺乏完整动力学测量时参数选择提供了理论框架。全局敏感性分析识别出PRC2介导的甲基化和KDM5A介导的去甲基化为主导控制参数，而随机模拟显示群体异质性，与癌细胞群体中观察到的可变EMT反应一致。我们的分析探讨了Notch信号通路与表观遗传调控在决定黑色素瘤细胞命运中的相互作用。
